verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Puzzle supports classes: "a user can create an unlimited number of Groups for Classes". It also offers one-click financial reports and exports of statements on a cash or accrual basis. However, no evidence documents building custom reports that are filtered or grouped by class, location, or tag, so class setup alone does not deliver this reporting story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
